renderings.value: Express contrast between two aspects; 'on the one hand', 'on the other hand'.
The ～反面 grammar point is used to show a contrast between two aspects of something. It can be translated as 'on the one hand' or 'on the other hand'.
Verb-casual + 反面, い-Adjective + 反面, な-Adjective + である反面, Noun + である反面
反面: one quality has a flip side in the same thing (便利な反面).
On the one hand, this car is fast, but on the other hand, it has poor fuel efficiency.
On the one hand, he is smart, but on the other hand, he's not good at sports.
On the one hand, she is kind, but on the other hand, she can be too helpful.
On the one hand, this job pays well, but on the other hand, it's quite stressful.
